case_number: Civil Appeal No 6693 of 2022; Civil Appeal No. 6694 of 2022

parties.petitioner: M/S Indian Medicines Pharmaceuticals Corporation Ltd
parties.respondent: Kerala Ayurvedic Co Operative Society Ltd. & Ors.

summary: Procurement of Ayurvedic medicines under National AYUSH Mission; validity of direct nomination to IMPCL without tenders; interpretation of Operational Guidelines para 4(vi)(b); mandatory tender process for at least 50% procurement to ensure quality and competition; State discretion limited by Central guidelines; High Court finding upheld; IMPCL not exclusive supplier despite government ownership.
legal_provisions_cited: National AYUSH Mission Operational Guidelines para 4(vi)(b)
final_judgment: Appeals dismissed; High Court judgment allowing petition under Article 226 affirmed; direction to invite tenders for procurement maintained.
